# midpoint_connector (Data Source)

Looks up the midPoint connector of a connector type (and version), so that configurations need not hard-code connector OIDs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the CSV connector installed on this midPoint server.
data "midpoint_connector" "csv" {
  connector_type = "com.evolveum.polygon.connector.csv.CsvConnector"
}

# Pin a version when the server has several versions of a connector type.
data "midpoint_connector" "csv_2_8" {
  connector_type    = "com.evolveum.polygon.connector.csv.CsvConnector"
  connector_version = "2.8"
}

output "csv_connector" {
  value = {
    oid     = data.midpoint_connector.csv.oid
    name    = data.midpoint_connector.csv.name
    version = data.midpoint_connector.csv.connector_version
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connector_type` (String) Connector type, e.g. com.evolveum.polygon.connector.csv.CsvConnector.

### Optional

- `connector_version` (String) Connector version, e.g. 2.8. Required when midPoint has several versions of the connector type; otherwise read from the connector found.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The connector OID.
- `name` (String) The connector name.
- `oid` (String) The connector OID.
